parameters.content:
## 05 Weekly advisor digest (Sun 18:00 IST)
One ClickUp task per advisor, due Monday 10:00, with a one-screen markdown digest:
- students sorted by **needs-attention** score (open alerts x3, focus down >20% WoW, <4 app days, quiz <60%)
- top 3 wins and top 3 risks across the advisor's students

All numbers come from `v_student_daily`, `student_alerts()` and `chapters`, the same sources as the Students dashboard.

parameters.query:
with p as (select ist_date(now()) - 6 as s, ist_date(now()) as e),
wk as (
  select d.student_id,
         sum(d.focus_minutes)::int                       as focus_min,
         round(avg(d.quiz_pct), 1)::float8               as quiz_pct,
         round(avg(d.timetable_adherence), 1)::float8    as timetable_pct,
         (count(*) filter (where d.app_minutes > 0))::int as app_days,
         round(avg(d.sleep_hours), 1)::float8            as sleep_h
  from v_student_daily d, p where d.date between p.s and p.e group by 1
),
prev as (
  select d.student_id, sum(d.focus_minutes)::int as focus_min, round(avg(d.quiz_pct), 1)::float8 as quiz_pct
  from v_student_daily d, p where d.date between p.s - 7 and p.s - 1 group by 1
),
alerts as (
  select student_id, count(*)::int as n, string_agg(detail, '; ' order by alert_type) as details
  from student_alerts(ist_date(now())) group by 1
),
ready as (
  select c.student_id, count(*)::int as chapters_ready
  from chapters c, p where c.stage = 5 and ist_date(c.updated_at) between p.s and p.e group by 1
),
milestones as (
  select m.student_id, count(*)::int as done
  from roadmap_milestones m, p where ist_date(m.done_at) between p.s and p.e group by 1
)
select a.id as advisor_id, a.name as advisor_name, a.clickup_user_id,
       s.name as student_name,
       coalesce(wk.focus_min, 0) as focus_min, prev.focus_min as prev_focus_min,
       wk.quiz_pct, prev.quiz_pct as prev_quiz_pct, wk.timetable_pct,
       coalesce(wk.app_days, 0) as app_days, wk.sleep_h,
       coalesce(al.n, 0) as open_alerts, al.details as alert_details,
       coalesce(r.chapters_ready, 0) as chapters_ready, coalesce(m.done, 0) as milestones_done,
       (coalesce(al.n, 0) * 3
        + case when coalesce(wk.focus_min, 0) < 0.8 * prev.focus_min then 1 else 0 end
        + case when coalesce(wk.app_days, 0) < 4 then 1 else 0 end
        + case when wk.quiz_pct < 60 then 1 else 0 end)::int as attention_score
from students s
join advisors a on a.id = s.advisor_id
left join wk on wk.student_id = s.id
left join prev on prev.student_id = s.id
left join alerts al on al.student_id = s.id
left join ready r on r.student_id = s.id
left join milestones m on m.student_id = s.id
order by a.id, attention_score desc, s.name

insert into ingest_log (workflow, rows, status, execution_id)
values ($1, $2, $3, $4)
